# rust.packages() lists the workspace members for a matrix, and
# rust.dependencies() each member's local dependencies, without
# development ones, as names or as references through a template.
[!exec:cargo] skip

bit --graph --json crate
cp stdout graph.json
[exec:jq] exec jq -e '. == {"crate[\"app\"]": ["crate[\"util\"]"], "crate[\"core\"]": [], "crate[\"util\"]": ["crate[\"core\"]"]}' graph.json

bit deps packages
grep '\Aapp core util\n\z' out/packages.txt
grep '\Autil\n\z' out/deps-app.txt
grep '\Acore\n\z' out/deps-util.txt
grep '\A\n\z' out/deps-core.txt

# Each slice builds its package after its dependencies.
bit -j1 crate
stdout 'crate\["core"\] ▶ cargo build -p core$(?s:.*)crate\["util"\] ▶ cargo build -p util$(?s:.*)crate\["app"\] ▶ cargo build -p app$'
exists target/debug/app

# A change in a package reruns the slices that build it.
exec cp main.rs.changed app/src/main.rs
bit crate
stdout 'crate\["core"\] · no changes'
stdout 'crate\["util"\] · no changes'
stdout 'crate\["app"\] ▶ .*app/src/main\.rs'

exec cp lib.rs.changed core/src/lib.rs
bit crate
stdout 'crate\["core"\] ✔ ok'
stdout 'crate\["util"\] ✔ ok'
stdout 'crate\["app"\] ✔ ok'
exec target/debug/app
stdout '\Autil\+core 2!\n\z'

-- BUILD.bit --
let package = rust.packages()

crate[package] = rust.build {
  package    = package
  depends_on = rust.dependencies(package, "crate[$]")
}

explicit deps[package] = exec {
  command = "mkdir -p out && echo #{shell_join(rust.dependencies(package))} > out/deps-#{package}.txt"
  outputs = ["out/deps-#{package}.txt"]
}

explicit packages = exec {
  command = "mkdir -p out && echo #{shell_join(rust.packages())} > out/packages.txt"
  outputs = ["out/packages.txt"]
}
-- Cargo.toml --
[workspace]
members = ["core", "util", "app"]
resolver = "2"
-- core/Cargo.toml --
[package]
name = "core"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
-- core/src/lib.rs --
pub fn word() -> &'static str {
    "core"
}
-- lib.rs.changed --
pub fn word() -> &'static str {
    "core 2"
}
-- util/Cargo.toml --
[package]
name = "util"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
core = { path = "../core" }
-- util/src/lib.rs --
pub fn word() -> String {
    format!("util+{}", core::word())
}
-- app/Cargo.toml --
[package]
name = "app"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
util = { path = "../util" }

[dev-dependencies]
core = { path = "../core" }
-- app/src/main.rs --
fn main() {
    println!("{}", util::word());
}
-- main.rs.changed --
fn main() {
    println!("{}!", util::word());
}
